chunks: Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “upright, a Muslim.” He said: “Pure, sincere, with nothing in him of the worship of idols.”

key_terms.حَنِيفًا: upright and inclining away from falsehood toward truth
key_terms.عِبَادَةِ الْأَوْثَانِ: the worship of idols, negated here completely
key_terms.مُخْلِصًا: sincere and devoted exclusively to Allah

ai.seo_question: What does ḥanīf and Muslim mean in the Quranic description of Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This passage explains the meaning of being ḥanīf and Muslim as purity and sincerity in devotion to Allah, free from any trace of idol worship. It emphasizes pure tawhid and exclusive worship without shirk.
